title: Why MCP and ChatGPT Apps Use Double Iframes — Frédéric Barthelet, Alpic
summary: Inspect ChatGPT's DOM while an MCP app is rendering and you find an iframe nested inside another iframe. Frédéric Barthelet traces why each simpler approach fails: `srcdoc` shares the parent origin so ChatGPT's CSP blocks all third party scripts; relaxing that CSP lets any app read ChatGPT's localStorage and cookies; adding `sandbox` removes origin indexed storage; adding `allow-same-origin` to restore …
